title: An AI glossary
subtitle: The most common AI terms explained, simply
summary: This glossary provides simple definitions for over 20 common AI terms, making complex concepts accessible for those unfamiliar with the jargon. It covers essential topics such as AI models, large language models, and training methods, while also addressing advanced techniques like reinforcement learning from human feedback and prompt engineering. The glossary serves as a handy reference for anyone looking to better understand the rapidly evolving field of artificial intelligence.

title: 10 contrarian leadership truths every leader needs to hear | Matt MacInnis (Rippling)
summary: In this episode, Matt MacInnis, Chief Product Officer at Rippling, shares his contrarian views on leadership and the necessity of extraordinary effort for achieving exceptional outcomes. He emphasizes the importance of under-staffing projects to avoid inefficiencies and politics, while advocating for a culture of intense feedback and escalation of issues. MacInnis also discusses the significance of maintaining high energy levels within teams to combat entropy and drive success in a competitive landscape.

title: How to find hidden growth opportunities in your product | Albert Cheng (Duolingo, Grammarly, Chess.com)
summary: In this episode, Albert Cheng, a leading growth strategist with experience at Duolingo, Grammarly, and Chess.com, shares insights on finding hidden growth opportunities in consumer subscription products. He emphasizes the importance of user retention, experimentation, and the balance between exploration and exploitation in growth strategies. Cheng discusses how leveraging AI and understanding user psychology can significantly enhance product engagement and retention.
